NL: 计算过去一年各年龄段（如 18-25 岁，26-40 岁，41-60 岁）人员的网络行为占比，分析哪些年龄段的人更活跃于网络，并细分常访问的网站类型或使用的网络服务。
SQL:
WITH age_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        g."gmsfhm", 
        g."xm", 
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
        (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
         (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) AS "age", 
        CASE
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) <= 18 THEN '0-18'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) BETWEEN 19 AND 24 THEN '19-24'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g."csrq") - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g."csrq") OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g."csrq") AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g."csrq"))) > 64 THEN '64+'
        END AS "age_group"
    FROM "main"."graph_tag_idcard_base" g
),
behavior AS (
    SELECT 
        ag."age_group", 
        r."domain", 
        COUNT(*) AS "behavior_count"
    FROM "main"."rzx_wz_wldt_logs" r
    JOIN age_groups ag 
        ON r."auth_account" = ag."gmsfhm"
    WHERE r."capture_time" >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 year') * 1000
    GROUP BY ag."age_group", r."domain"
),
age_behavior_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        age_group, 
        SUM(behavior_count) AS "total_behavior_count"
    FROM behavior
    GROUP BY age_group
)
SELECT 
    b."age_group", 
    b."domain", 
    b."behavior_count", 
    ROUND(b."behavior_count" * 100.0 / a."total_behavior_count", 2) AS "behavior_percentage"
FROM behavior b
JOIN age_behavior_summary a
    ON b."age_group" = a."age_group"
ORDER BY b."age_group", b."behavior_count" DESC;

NL: 计算各个行政区内本地居民 vs 外来人口的占比
SQL:
WITH population_distribution AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) AS district,
        CASE
            WHEN g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail LIKE '%特别行政区%' THEN g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '市') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '市'))
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') + 1)
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') + 3)
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') + 1)
            ELSE g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail
        END AS city,
        COUNT(*) AS total_population,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) = SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4) THEN 1
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS local_population,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) != SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4) THEN 1
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS foreign_population
    FROM main.graph_tag_idcard_base g
    LEFT JOIN main.res_zh_gj_info r
        ON r.id_card = g.gmsfhm
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4), city
),
merged_population_distribution AS (
    SELECT 
        district,
        MAX(city) AS city, 
        SUM(local_population) AS local_population,
        SUM(foreign_population) AS foreign_population,
        SUM(total_population) AS total_population
    FROM population_distribution
    GROUP BY district
)
SELECT 
    md.district,
    md.city,
    md.local_population,
    md.foreign_population,
    ROUND(md.local_population * 100.0 / md.total_population, 2) AS local_population_percentage,
    ROUND(md.foreign_population * 100.0 / md.total_population, 2) AS foreign_population_percentage
FROM merged_population_distribution md
ORDER BY md.district;

NL: 分析各个行政区外来人口的来源地占比
SQL:
WITH foreign_population_sources AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) AS district,
        CASE
            WHEN g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail LIKE '%特别行政区%' THEN g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '市') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '市'))
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') + 2)
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') + 3)
            WHEN INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') + 1)
            ELSE g.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail
        END AS city,
        SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4) AS source_district,
        CASE
            WHEN g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail LIKE '%特别行政区%' THEN g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail
            WHEN INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '市') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '市'))
            WHEN INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '地区') + 2)
            WHEN INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '自治州') + 3)
            WHEN INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, 1, INSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail, '盟') + 1)
            ELSE g.lzdq_ssxqdm_detail
        END AS source_city,
        COUNT(*) AS foreign_population_count
    FROM main.graph_tag_idcard_base g
    LEFT JOIN main.res_zh_gj_info r
        ON r.id_card = g.gmsfhm
    WHERE SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) != SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4)
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4), city, SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4), source_city
),
total_foreign_population AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) AS district,
        COUNT(*) AS total_foreign_population_count
    FROM main.graph_tag_idcard_base g
    LEFT JOIN main.res_zh_gj_info r
        ON r.id_card = g.gmsfhm
    WHERE SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4) != SUBSTR(g.lzdq_ssxqdm, 1, 4)
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(g.hjdz_ssxqdm, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
    f.district,
    f.city,
    f.source_district,
    f.source_city,
    f.foreign_population_count,
    ROUND(f.foreign_population_count * 100.0 / t.total_foreign_population_count, 2) AS source_population_percentage
FROM foreign_population_sources f
JOIN total_foreign_population t
    ON f.district = t.district
ORDER BY f.district, f.source_district;

NL: 监测人员在短时间内从 A 地到 B 地的轨迹变化，分析是否有非正常交通方式（如换乘他人车辆、隐藏身份）。
SQL:
WITH OrderedTrace AS (
    SELECT
        gj.id_card,
        gj.name,
        gj.start_time,
        gj.end_time,
        gj.from_place,
        gj.to_place,
        gj.car_number,
        gj.phone_no,
        gj.trace_status,
        gj.trace_type_name,
        gj.trace_source_name,
        gj.from_place_address,
        gj.to_place_address,
        gj.from_place_latitude,
        gj.from_place_longitude,
        gj.to_place_latitude,
        gj.to_place_longitude,
        LAG(gj.end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY gj.id_card ORDER BY gj.start_time, gj.create_time, gj.id) AS prev_end_time,
        LAG(gj.to_place) OVER (PARTITION BY gj.id_card ORDER BY gj.start_time, gj.create_time, gj.id) AS prev_to_place,
        LAG(gj.car_number) OVER (PARTITION BY gj.id_card ORDER BY gj.start_time, gj.create_time, gj.id) AS prev_car_number,
        LAG(gj.phone_no) OVER (PARTITION BY gj.id_card ORDER BY gj.start_time, gj.create_time, gj.id) AS prev_phone_no,
        julianday(gj.start_time) - julianday(
            LAG(gj.end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY gj.id_card ORDER BY gj.start_time, gj.create_time, gj.id)
        ) AS time_diff_days
    FROM res_zh_gj_info gj
    WHERE gj.id_card IS NOT NULL
),
VehicleOwnershipCheck AS (
    SELECT
        hphm AS car_number,
        sfzmhm AS car_owner_id
    FROM res_0_clda_jdc
    WHERE sfzmhm IS NOT NULL
),
PersonBase AS (
    SELECT
        gmsfhm AS id_card,
        xm AS real_name,
        xbdm_detail AS gender,
        csrq AS birthday
    FROM graph_tag_idcard_base
)
SELECT 
    ot.id_card,
    pb.real_name,
    pb.gender,
    pb.birthday,
    ot.start_time,
    ot.end_time,
    ot.time_diff_days,
    ot.prev_end_time,
    ot.prev_to_place,
    ot.from_place,
    ot.to_place,
    ot.car_number,
    CASE 
        WHEN voc.car_owner_id IS NULL THEN '未知车主'
        WHEN voc.car_owner_id != ot.id_card THEN '非本人车辆'
        ELSE '本人车辆'
    END AS car_ownership_status,
    ot.phone_no,
    ot.prev_phone_no,
    CASE 
        WHEN ot.phone_no != ot.prev_phone_no THEN '手机号变更'
        ELSE '手机号一致'
    END AS phone_status,
    ot.trace_status,
    ot.trace_type_name,
    ot.trace_source_name,
    ot.from_place_address,
    ot.to_place_address
FROM OrderedTrace ot
LEFT JOIN VehicleOwnershipCheck voc ON ot.car_number = voc.car_number
LEFT JOIN PersonBase pb ON ot.id_card = pb.id_card
WHERE 
    ot.time_diff_days IS NOT NULL
    AND ot.time_diff_days < 0.05
    AND ot.prev_to_place IS NOT NULL
    AND ot.from_place != ot.prev_to_place
    AND (
        voc.car_owner_id IS NULL OR voc.car_owner_id != ot.id_card
        OR ot.phone_no != ot.prev_phone_no
    )
ORDER BY ot.id_card, ot.start_time;

NL: 对比不同行政区的跨区通勤率
SQL:
SELECT 
    r.district,
    SUM(r.total_flow) AS total_flow,
    SUM(r.cross_district_flow) AS cross_district_flow,
    ROUND(SUM(r.cross_district_flow) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(r.total_flow), 0), 2) AS commuting_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        r.from_place_location_code AS district,
        COUNT(*) AS total_flow,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.from_place_location_code != r.to_place_location_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cross_district_flow
    FROM main.res_zh_gj_info r
    GROUP BY r.from_place_location_code
    UNION
    SELECT 
        r.to_place_location_code AS district,
        COUNT(*) AS total_flow,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.from_place_location_code != r.to_place_location_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cross_district_flow
    FROM main.res_zh_gj_info r
    GROUP BY r.to_place_location_code
) r
GROUP BY r.district
ORDER BY r.district;

NL: 对比不同职业（如白领、学生、工人、自由职业者）人员的主要通勤方式（公交、私家车、共享单车）、平均通勤时长、通勤距离，分析各职业群体的出行模式。
SQL:
WITH commuting_data AS (
    SELECT 
        p.cyzk_zy AS occupation,
        r.from_place AS start_location,
        r.to_place AS end_location,
        r.trace_type_name AS commuting_mode,
        (julianday(r.end_time) - julianday(r.start_time)) * 24 * 60 AS commute_duration_minutes,
        ( 6371 * acos(
            cos(radians(CAST(r.from_place_latitude AS REAL))) * cos(radians(CAST(r.to_place_latitude AS REAL))) * 
            cos(radians(CAST(r.to_place_longitude AS REAL)) - radians(CAST(r.from_place_longitude AS REAL))) + 
            sin(radians(CAST(r.from_place_latitude AS REAL))) * sin(radians(CAST(r.to_place_latitude AS REAL)))
        )) AS commute_distance_km
    FROM main.res_zh_gj_info r
    JOIN main.graph_tag_idcard_base p ON r.id_card = p.gmsfhm
    WHERE r.start_time IS NOT NULL AND r.end_time IS NOT NULL
),
occupation_commuting_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        occupation,
        commuting_mode,
        AVG(commute_duration_minutes) AS avg_commute_duration,
        AVG(commute_distance_km) AS avg_commute_distance,
        COUNT(*) AS commute_count
    FROM commuting_data
    GROUP BY occupation, commuting_mode
)
SELECT 
    occupation,
    commuting_mode,
    avg_commute_duration,
    avg_commute_distance,
    commute_count
FROM occupation_commuting_stats
ORDER BY occupation, commute_count DESC;

NL: 在晚上12：00后经常上网的是什么人群？
SQL:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS visit_count,
    base.gmsfhm AS id_card,
    base.xm AS real_name, 
    base.xbdm_detail AS gender, 
    base.csrq AS birth_date, 
    base.hjdz_ssxqdm_detail AS address,
    base.cyzk_zy,
    base.hyzkdm_detail,
    base.xldm_detail
FROM rzx_wz_wldt_logs AS logs
JOIN graph_tag_idcard_base AS base
    ON logs.auth_account = base.gmsfhm OR logs.auth_account = base.lxdh
WHERE strftime('%H', datetime(logs.capture_time / 1000, 'unixepoch')) >= '00'
  AND strftime('%H', datetime(logs.capture_time / 1000, 'unixepoch')) < '06'
GROUP BY base.gmsfhm
ORDER BY visit_count DESC;

NL: 张三过去 6 个月去过哪些地方？
SQL:
SELECT 
    id_card,
    place
FROM (
    SELECT 
        r.id_card,
        r.from_place AS place
    FROM res_zh_gj_info r
    WHERE r.name = '张三'
      AND r.start_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-6 months') * 1000

    UNION

    SELECT 
        r.id_card,
        r.to_place AS place
    FROM res_zh_gj_info r
    WHERE r.name = '张三'
      AND r.start_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-6 months') * 1000
) AS places
GROUP BY id_card, place
ORDER BY id_card, place;

NL: 深圳年轻一代喜欢开什么牌子的车？
SQL:
WITH young_people AS (
  SELECT 
        gmsfhm, 
        xm, 
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', csrq) AS age
    FROM 
        graph_tag_idcard_base
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', csrq) BETWEEN 18 AND 35
        AND jg_ssxqdm LIKE '%4403%'
),
young_people_cars AS (
    SELECT
        y.gmsfhm,
        y.xm,
        c.clpp1 AS brand
    FROM
        young_people y
    JOIN
        res_0_clda_jdc c ON y.gmsfhm = c.sfzmhm
)
SELECT
    brand,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
    young_people_cars
GROUP BY
    brand
ORDER BY
    count DESC;

NL: 将2025年3月行程最远的前40名人员排序
SQL:
WITH trip_distance AS (
    SELECT
        id_card,
        name,
        (
            6371 * acos(
                cos(radians(CAST(from_place_latitude AS REAL))) * 
                cos(radians(CAST(to_place_latitude AS REAL))) *
                cos(radians(CAST(to_place_longitude AS REAL)) - radians(CAST(from_place_longitude AS REAL))) +
                sin(radians(CAST(from_place_latitude AS REAL))) *
                sin(radians(CAST(to_place_latitude AS REAL)))
            )
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM
        res_zh_gj_info
    WHERE
        start_time >= '2025-03-01' AND start_time < '2025-04-01'
        AND from_place_latitude IS NOT NULL AND from_place_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND to_place_latitude IS NOT NULL AND to_place_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
person_total_distance AS (
    SELECT
        id_card,
        name,
        SUM(distance_km) AS total_distance_km
    FROM
        trip_distance
    GROUP BY
        id_card, name
)
SELECT
    id_card,
    name,
    total_distance_km
FROM
    person_total_distance
ORDER BY
    total_distance_km DESC
LIMIT 40;

NL: 不同年龄段的人过去 1 年的平均出行次数是多少？
SQL:
WITH age_groups AS (
    SELECT
        g.gmsfhm AS id_card,
        CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) AS age,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 17 THEN '0-17'
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '18-24'
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
            WHEN CAST((julianday(CURRENT_DATE) - julianday(g.csrq)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
            ELSE '65+'
        END AS age_group
    FROM graph_tag_idcard_base g
),
travel_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r.id_card, 
        COUNT(*) AS travel_count
    FROM res_zh_gj_info r
    WHERE r.start_time >= date('now', '-1 year')
    GROUP BY r.id_card
)
SELECT
    ag.age_group,
    AVG(tc.travel_count) AS avg_travel_count
FROM age_groups ag
JOIN travel_counts tc ON ag.id_card = tc.id_card
GROUP BY ag.age_group
ORDER BY ag.age_group;

NL: 比较不同年龄段（18-25 岁，26-40 岁，41-60 岁）人员的上网时长、访问的网站类型、使用的社交媒体平台，分析各年龄段的上网偏好差异。
SQL:
WITH age_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        g.gmsfhm, 
        g.xm, 
        strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
        (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
         (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) AS age, 
        CASE
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) <= 18 THEN '0-18'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) BETWEEN 19 AND 24 THEN '19-24'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', g.csrq) - 
                 (strftime('%m', 'now') < strftime('%m', g.csrq) OR 
                  (strftime('%m', 'now') = strftime('%m', g.csrq) AND strftime('%d', 'now') < strftime('%d', g.csrq))) > 64 THEN '64+'
        END AS age_group
    FROM graph_tag_idcard_base g
),
online_behavior AS (
    SELECT 
        ag.age_group, 
        r.domain, 
        r.app_type, 
        COUNT(*) AS activity_count
    FROM main.rzx_wz_wldt_logs r
    JOIN age_groups ag 
        ON r.auth_account = ag.gmsfhm
    WHERE r.capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 year') * 1000
    GROUP BY ag.age_group, r.domain, r.app_type
),
age_behavior_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        age_group, 
        SUM(activity_count) AS total_activity_count
    FROM online_behavior
    GROUP BY age_group
)
SELECT 
    ob.age_group, 
    ob.domain, 
    ob.activity_count, 
    ROUND(ob.activity_count * 100.0 / ab.total_activity_count, 2) AS activity_percentage,  
    ob.app_type
FROM online_behavior ob
JOIN age_behavior_summary ab
    ON ob.age_group = ab.age_group
ORDER BY ob.age_group, ob.activity_count DESC;

NL: 对比不同行政区的流动频率
SQL:
WITH inflow_count AS (
    SELECT 
        r.to_place_location_code AS district,
        COUNT(*) AS inflow
    FROM main.res_zh_gj_info r
    GROUP BY r.to_place_location_code
),
outflow_count AS (
    SELECT 
        r.from_place_location_code AS district,
        COUNT(*) AS outflow
    FROM main.res_zh_gj_info r
    GROUP BY r.from_place_location_code
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(i.district, o.district) AS district,
    COALESCE(i.inflow, 0) AS inflow,
    COALESCE(o.outflow, 0) AS outflow,
    ROUND(COALESCE(i.inflow, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(o.outflow, 0), 0), 2) AS inflow_outflow_ratio,
    ROUND(COALESCE(i.inflow, 0) - COALESCE(o.outflow, 0), 2) AS net_migration
FROM inflow_count i
FULL OUTER JOIN outflow_count o 
    ON i.district = o.district
ORDER BY district;

NL: 各民族人民都开什么车多一些？
SQL:
SELECT 
    p.mzdm_detail AS 民族,
    v.clpp1 AS 品牌,
    COUNT(*) AS 车辆数量
FROM 
    graph_tag_idcard_base p
JOIN 
    main.res_0_clda_jdc v ON p.gmsfhm = v.sfzmhm AND v.sfzmmc = '身份证'
GROUP BY 
    p.mzdm_detail, v.clpp1, v.clpp2
ORDER BY 
    p.mzdm_detail, COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.xm AS 家庭成员姓名,
    p.hh AS 户号,
    p.yhzgxdm_detail AS 与户主的关系,
    v.hphm AS 号牌号码,
    v.clpp1 AS 品牌,
    v.clxh AS 车辆型号,
    v.csys AS 车身颜色
FROM 
    graph_tag_idcard_base p
JOIN 
    main.res_0_clda_jdc v ON p.gmsfhm = v.sfzmhm AND v.sfzmmc = '身份证'
WHERE 
    p.hh IN (SELECT hh FROM graph_tag_idcard_base WHERE xm = '张三')
ORDER BY p.hh, p.yhzgxdm;

NL: 计算所有车辆过去 6 个月内的轨迹记录次数，分析哪些车辆活动频繁。
SQL:
WITH vehicle_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        r.car_number,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM res_zh_gj_info r
    WHERE r.car_number IS NOT NULL
    AND r.car_number != ''
    AND r.capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-6 months') * 1000
    GROUP BY r.car_number
)
SELECT 
    v.car_number,
    v.track_count
FROM vehicle_tracks v
JOIN res_0_clda_jdc c
    ON v.car_number = c.hphm
ORDER BY v.track_count DESC;

NL: 列出过去六个月，各地区网络通信次数
SQL:
SELECT ip_address, SUM(total_access_count) AS total_access_count
FROM (
    SELECT src_ip_address AS ip_address, COUNT(*) AS total_access_count
    FROM rzx_wz_wldt_logs
    WHERE capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-6 months') * 1000
    GROUP BY src_ip_address

    UNION ALL

    SELECT dst_ip_address AS ip_address, COUNT(*) AS total_access_count
    FROM rzx_wz_wldt_logs
    WHERE capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-6 months') * 1000
    GROUP BY dst_ip_address
) AS combined
GROUP BY ip_address
ORDER BY total_access_count DESC;

NL: 计算过去一年人员轨迹数据中，不同区域（如商圈、住宅区、学校、政府机构等）出现的占比，分析人员活动的主要分布范围。
SQL:
SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN r.from_place LIKE '%商圈%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%商圈%' OR r.from_place LIKE '%购物中心%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%购物中心%' THEN '商圈'
        WHEN r.from_place LIKE '%小区%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%小区%' OR r.from_place LIKE '%家园%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%家园%' THEN '住宅区'
        WHEN r.from_place LIKE '%大学%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%大学%' 
            OR r.from_place LIKE '%中学%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%中学%' 
            OR r.from_place LIKE '%小学%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%小学%' 
            OR r.from_place LIKE '%学校%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%学校%' 
            OR r.from_place LIKE '%学院%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%学院%' THEN '学校'
        WHEN r.from_place LIKE '%政府%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%政府%' 
            OR r.from_place LIKE '%公安局%' OR r.to_place LIKE '%公安局%' THEN '政府机构'
        ELSE '其他'
    END AS region_type,
    COUNT(*) AS activity_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM res_zh_gj_info WHERE capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 year') * 1000), 2) AS activity_percentage
FROM res_zh_gj_info r
WHERE r.capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 year') * 1000
GROUP BY region_type
ORDER BY activity_count DESC;

SQL:
SELECT 
    a.gmsfhm,
    a.xm,
    a.csrq,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', a.csrq)) AS age,
    a.xbdm_detail,
    a.hyzkdm_detail,
    a.lxdh,
    a.lzdq_qhnxxdz,
    b.hphm,
    b.clpp1,
    b.clxh,
    b.xsjg
FROM 
    graph_tag_idcard_base a
JOIN 
    res_0_clda_jdc b
ON 
    a.gmsfhm = b.sfzmhm
WHERE 
    a.lzdq_qhnxxdz LIKE '%湘桥区%'
    AND strftime('%Y', a.qrrq) = '2024'
    AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', a.csrq)) BETWEEN 25 AND 35
    AND a.xbdm_detail = '女'
    AND a.hyzkdm_detail = '已婚'
    AND b.xsjg > 500000
    AND b.zt = '在用';

NL: 过去 1 年，每个用户的IP 地址变更次数是多少？
SQL:
WITH ip_changes AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ip_count
    FROM rzx_wz_wldt_logs
    WHERE capture_time >= strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 year') * 1000
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    ip_count - 1 AS ip_change_count
FROM ip_changes
GROUP BY user_id;
